audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-3 were Skill/Kayle/Kayle in both layers while every prose line for those stages says Gnar owns them ('concede the stage', 'give nothing and farm safe', 'Still melee and behind'). The packet chart and the already-audited Gnar-side page both give Gnar levels 1-3.
audit.why: Mini-Gnar's Boomerang Throw is 1100 range against Kayle's melee autos, and Hop sidesteps Radiant Blast, so there is no early stage Kayle can contest.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 flipped to Gnar in both layers as one atomic group, ratings lowered to 3/10, and the three phases[].why lines rewritten to match. Levels 4-5 and Level 6 left Skill and the last two rows left Kayle, matching the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 phase was generic filler and gave no cooldown for Divine Judgment.
audit.why: Level 6 is the flip: Divine Ascent matches his range and R is a 160s rank-1 answer that zeroes the Mega GNAR! all-in damage. Timing it to his commit is the whole skill.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Divine Ascent, R's 160s, and the exact timing against the Mega stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said GNAR! stuns against terrain and cuts a retreat that Kayle has no dash to make.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage.' Kayle's kit has no dash, so Flash is her only answer to being thrown into a wall — and the invulnerability blanks the damage, not the stun.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now tells the reader to hold Flash for the wall rather than to trade it for damage.

edits.before: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Identify how Gnar contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — Boomerang Throw out-ranges your melee autos, so last-hit at max range and concede.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Gnar's GNAR! is down.
edits.after: He pokes with Q and hops (E) over your Radiant Blast — give nothing and farm at max range.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gnar must walk into your range.
edits.after: Still melee and out-ranged — soak his poke, protect your health bar, and hold the wave near your tower for 6.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gnar's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged and R (160s) zeroes the damage of his Mega GNAR! stun — ult yourself the instant he commits, not before.

edits.before: His Mega all-in. R-invuln it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: GNAR! stuns you into a wall and you have no dash — hold Flash for it.

notes: Rows 0-2 flipped to Gnar in both layers as one group, matching the packet chart and the Gnar-side audit. Levels 4-5 and Level 6 left as Skill deliberately: the packet gives level 6 to Kayle, but the mirror settled on Skill and the two directions must agree — flagged rather than fought. Divine Judgment blanks the Mega GNAR! damage but not the stun itself; the page already states this correctly in mid and it was left intact. phases[1] and phases[2] ratings left at 5/10 — only phases[0] had a rating I could justify moving from the kit data.
